name: dsh-aa-bridge
description: AA bridge connector for the DeepSeek Harness tool seam (ctx.tools). At boot it fetches the aa-bridge HTTP tool catalog (GET /api/tools) and dynamically registers each bridge tool as a native harness tool prefixed with aa_; execute forwards to POST /api/tools/call and passes the bridge response through. When the bridge is unreachable it logs a warning and registers nothing — the host always boots.
